description: This file defines a custom JSON converter for serializing and deserializing Orleans streaming objects, specifically handling StreamImpl and IAsyncStream types. It interacts with Orleans runtime components to reconstruct stream instances from their JSON representations.

classes.name: StreamImplConverter
classes.description: A custom JSON converter for handling serialization and deserialization of Orleans stream implementation objects, facilitating their reconstruction from JSON data.

methods.name: StreamImplConverter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the converter with an Orleans runtime client.

methods.name: CanConvert
methods.description: Determines if the converter can handle the specified object type, particularly StreamImpl<> and IAsyncStream<> types.

methods.name: ReadJson
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into an Orleans stream object by extracting stream metadata and reconstructing the stream instance.

methods.name: WriteJson
methods.description: Serializes an Orleans stream object into JSON, capturing its stream ID, provider name, and rewindability.
